main_measure.name: mean position-weighted unusual weekend move (forecast/10 x (2-day return - coin mean 2-day return))

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one Friday summed across coins

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 100 distinct Fridays and size check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 100 distinct Fridays

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move in forecast direction, upper minus lower half of |forecast|

decided_by: the mean weighted unusual move is above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 100 distinct Fridays, and the size check's difference is above 0.
reading: All regime-'trending' bars with a close two bars later in the same window are cases (forecast 0 included, weighing 0), the coin's mean 2-day return is taken on the non-overlapping 0,2,4,... grid of all its windows pooled, and the median split puts |forecast| above the median in the upper half and the rest in the lower half.
